reason: A named independent lab with the batch report behind a QR code is exactly what I look for, and bisglycinate with no oxide at 200 mg is a real dose. At $24.99 for the first box I would try one and check the report before I order a second.
objection: Made in China. I want to open the report and confirm the lab is real and the batch number matches, not just trust that it says so on the page.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR code led to a generic or missing report, or the lab name did not check out, I would not buy.
